answers.core: A game’s aspect ratio is an important design choice and having an option to set it in stone while accommodating for different screen resolutions should be a no-brainer.
answers.workaround: I think it would be used often, but maybe I’m wrong? I’ve seen a few implementations out there searching for a solution, but they are extremely glitchy on Godot 4. I wrote a script to do it using `DisplayServer.window_set_size` and `root.size_changed` and while that technically works, the renderer distorts everything to accomodate for the “wrong” aspect ratio. If that can be worked around by tweaking the script, I am too stupid to do so.

title: Add a window scaling option to keep the window’s aspect ratio
